verdict.rationale: Babylon.js exposes glTF/OBJ/STL import via a programmatic SceneLoader API and can run headlessly via NullEngine/server-side rendering (babylonjs-docs-2, babylonjs-docs-3, babylonjs-docs-6, babylonjs-docs-8), which implies imports can be scripted rather than hand-clicked, but there is no dedicated documentation of import hooks, batch presets, or a formal asset-pipeline/automation tool for technical artists. Missing for 10: explicit pipeline/preset tooling, CLI or build-step asset processors, documented hook system for custom import automation, and independent evidence of technical artists using it this way.
